name: Slonks
description: A 10,000-piece ERC-721 collection of CryptoPunks reconstructed on-chain by a neural model and rendered live.
about:
## About Slonks

Slonks are on-chain neural reconstructions of CryptoPunks. A compact image model, trained on the full CryptoPunks set and stored on-chain, regenerates each 24x24 image directly from the contract — no image files are uploaded. The pixels where the model disagrees with the original punk are the artwork; that divergence is measured as a token's "slop" (0 to 576, the pixel count of the canvas). "Slop is the art."

## System of contracts

This contract is a SeaDrop-compatible ERC-721A shell holding ownership, minting, transfer, and the reveal that maps each token to its CryptoPunks source id. It delegates all metadata and imagery to an updatable renderer:

- **SlonksRenderer** (`0x726383bd28fa1f95a7e3d300babf08f6444d0437`) assembles `tokenURI`, imagery, and attributes.
- **SlonksImageModel** (`0xca116243a2013ed33015c776ee37310b199ee80c`) is the on-chain neural network.
- **SlonksPixelCanvas** (`0x690d67bb6042c778c06ec9ba182a3032247893d4`) is an optional paint layer.
- **SlopGameV2** (`0x76c61b6140600429f50de5ac987e41672047cc28`) runs the void / $SLOP game and active embedding state, and is an authorized metadata updater on this contract.
- **SlonksMergeManager** (`0x7bda4820dbcfe471a2e23d3fa069c1cd261401e1`) records merges.

Max supply is permanently fixed at 10,000, minting started at token id 0, and all 10,000 tokens have been minted. Burns reduce live `totalSupply` but do not reopen mint capacity.

## Reveal

The one-time reveal has been finalized. Its seed permanently fixes the mapping from each token to its CryptoPunks source id; the reveal cannot be committed or finalized again.
risks: Swappable renderer — the owner can change the renderer, altering all displayed art and metadata
The owner can authorize arbitrary metadata-updater contracts that trigger ERC-4906 refreshes

totalSupply.title: Total Supply
totalSupply.description: The number of Slonks currently in existence (minted minus burned).

MAX_SUPPLY.title: Max Supply
MAX_SUPPLY.description: The permanent maximum supply of 10,000 Slonks; this value can never change.

slonksRenderer.title: Renderer
slonksRenderer.description: The renderer contract that produces metadata and imagery for every token.

remainingSourceIds.title: Remaining Source IDs
remainingSourceIds.description: How many source ids are still unassigned in the mint-time shuffle pool.

royaltyInfo.title: Royalty Info
royaltyInfo.description: The ERC-2981 receiver and royalty amount, using the same currency units as the supplied sale price.

sourceIdFor.title: Source Punk ID
sourceIdFor.description: The CryptoPunks source id a token reconstructs, available only after reveal.

baseSourceIdFor.title: Base Source ID
baseSourceIdFor.description: The pre-shuffle base source id assigned to a token at mint time.

revealed.title: Revealed
revealed.description: Whether the one-time source-punk shuffle has been finalized.

revealSeed.title: Reveal Seed
revealSeed.description: The seed derived from the committed block hash that fixes the shuffle.

revealBlockNumber.title: Reveal Block
revealBlockNumber.description: The committed future block whose hash will seed the reveal.

shuffleOffset.title: Shuffle Offset
shuffleOffset.description: The global offset applied to map base source ids to final source punk ids.

commitReveal.title: Commit Reveal
commitReveal.description: The one-time reveal is already finalized, so this call reverts.
commitReveal.deprecated: Unavailable: the collection has already been revealed.

finalizeReveal.title: Finalize Reveal
finalizeReveal.description: The one-time reveal is already finalized, so this call reverts.
finalizeReveal.deprecated: Unavailable: the collection has already been revealed.

burn.title: Burn
burn.description: Permanently destroy a token you own or are approved for.
burn.warning: Burning is irreversible and permanently removes the token.

setSlonksRenderer.title: Set Renderer
setSlonksRenderer.description: Point the collection at a new renderer contract. Only the owner can call this.
setSlonksRenderer.warning: Changes the art and metadata shown for every token in the collection.

setMetadataUpdater.title: Set Metadata Updater
setMetadataUpdater.description: Authorize or revoke a contract allowed to emit ERC-4906 metadata updates. Only the owner can call this.

metadataUpdaters.title: Is Metadata Updater
metadataUpdaters.description: Check whether an address is authorized to emit metadata updates.

emitMetadataUpdate.title: Emit Metadata Update
emitMetadataUpdate.description: Signal an ERC-4906 refresh for one token. Only the owner or an authorized updater can call this.

emitAllMetadataUpdate.title: Emit All Metadata Updates
emitAllMetadataUpdate.description: Signal an ERC-4906 refresh for every minted token. Only the owner or an authorized updater can call this.

setMaxSupply.title: Set Max Supply
setMaxSupply.description: SeaDrop hook that only accepts 10,000; the supply is permanently immutable.

setBaseURI.title: Set Base URI
setBaseURI.description: Set the base URI stored on the contract. Only the owner can call this.

setProvenanceHash.title: Set Provenance Hash
setProvenanceHash.description: Minting has already started, so the provenance hash can no longer be changed.
setProvenanceHash.deprecated: Unavailable: provenance is frozen after the first mint.

setRoyaltyInfo.title: Set Royalty Info
setRoyaltyInfo.description: Update the ERC-2981 royalty receiver and basis points. Only the owner can call this.

mintSeaDrop.title: Mint (SeaDrop)
mintSeaDrop.description: All 10,000 tokens have already been minted, so further SeaDrop mints revert.
mintSeaDrop.deprecated: Unavailable: lifetime mint supply is exhausted.

multiConfigure.title: Configure Drop
multiConfigure.description: Batch-configure SeaDrop drop parameters in one call. Only the owner can call this.

transferOwnership.title: Transfer Ownership
transferOwnership.description: Begin a two-step transfer of contract ownership. Only the owner can call this.

acceptOwnership.title: Accept Ownership
acceptOwnership.description: Complete a two-step ownership transfer. Only the pending owner can call this.

RevealCommitted.title: Reveal Committed
RevealCommitted.description: Emitted when a future block is committed for the reveal.

Revealed.title: Revealed
Revealed.description: Emitted when the reveal is finalized and the source-punk shuffle is fixed.

SlonksRendererUpdated.title: Renderer Updated
SlonksRendererUpdated.description: Emitted when the renderer contract is changed.

MetadataUpdaterUpdated.title: Metadata Updater Updated
MetadataUpdaterUpdated.description: Emitted when a metadata updater is authorized or revoked.

MetadataUpdate.title: Metadata Update
MetadataUpdate.description: ERC-4906 event signaling that one token's metadata changed.

BatchMetadataUpdate.title: Batch Metadata Update
BatchMetadataUpdate.description: ERC-4906 event signaling that a range of tokens' metadata changed.

InvalidSlonkId.title: Invalid Slonk ID
InvalidSlonkId.description: The token id is out of range or does not exist.

SlonksRendererNotSet.title: Renderer Not Set
SlonksRendererNotSet.description: No renderer is configured, so metadata cannot be produced.

NotRevealed.title: Not Revealed
NotRevealed.description: The source-punk shuffle has not been revealed yet.

AlreadyRevealed.title: Already Revealed
AlreadyRevealed.description: The reveal has already been finalized and cannot be repeated.

RevealNotCommitted.title: Reveal Not Committed
RevealNotCommitted.description: No reveal block has been committed yet.

RevealAlreadyCommitted.title: Reveal Already Committed
RevealAlreadyCommitted.description: A reveal block is already committed and still usable.

RevealBlockNotReady.title: Reveal Block Not Ready
RevealBlockNotReady.description: The committed block has not been mined yet.

RevealBlockHashExpired.title: Reveal Block Hash Expired
RevealBlockHashExpired.description: The committed block hash is older than 256 blocks and can no longer be used.

RevealBlockHashUnavailable.title: Reveal Block Hash Unavailable
RevealBlockHashUnavailable.description: The committed block hash is not available from the chain.

MaxSupplyImmutable.title: Max Supply Immutable
MaxSupplyImmutable.description: The max supply is permanently 10,000 and cannot be changed.

NotMetadataUpdater.title: Not Metadata Updater
NotMetadataUpdater.description: The caller is not authorized to emit metadata updates.

ZeroAddress.title: Zero Address
ZeroAddress.description: A required address argument was the zero address.
